utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Hannah speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, it’s Ewan Okonkwo. I’ve been charged unarranged overdraft fees and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been frustrating, Ewan. I’ll look into it with you. Before we discuss your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s verified, thank you. I can see why those charges would be upsetting. I’ll make sure the fees are refunded for you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s good to hear. There were three charges last month, and I don’t think they’re fair.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I’m logging this as a complaint about the unarranged overdraft fees. The complaint reference is TB-604183.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll take ownership and send the complaint to our complaints team today. I’ll check in with you by phone by Friday, 30 October, with an update.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And when will I get the final answer?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: We’ll investigate what happened and send you a full written response within 8 weeks. That response will explain our findings and any action taken.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise: I’ve logged your complaint about the three fees, I’ll pass it to the complaints team today, and I’ll call you by 30 October with an update. You’ll receive a full written response within 8 weeks. Does that all make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, Ewan. I’m sorry again for the frustration, and I’ll make sure it’s followed up.
